intro: Each group carries the evidence behind it. Confidence is stated honestly — including the gaps.

groups.title: Frontend
groups.note: 8 Angular apps · Vue 3 CRM at ~61% of 616 commits

groups.title: Mobile
groups.note: 6 Flutter apps · 2 published to both stores

groups.title: Backend
groups.note: Microservices behind CRM, website and social products

groups.title: Database
groups.note: Offline-first modelling in three different stacks

groups.title: AI
groups.note: In production since 2024 — integration, not model work

groups.title: DevOps & quality
groups.note: 20+ mobile releases · two store review processes

gaps.title: Automated test coverage
gaps.body: Thin in employer repositories. I compensated with documented manual QA, emulator tooling and targeted regression tests — and I would unit-test the GPS filters, sync queue and auth middleware first.

gaps.title: Cloud-native infrastructure
gaps.body: PM2, nginx and GitHub Actions on single hosts, with Docker basics. No Kubernetes, and no message broker or event streaming — I used crons and outbox collections, and can say exactly what a queue would add.

gaps.title: ML and model work
gaps.body: None. I integrate LLM APIs in production and build the tooling around them; that is the claim, and it is the accurate one.
